package.name: humanoid_transport_mujoco
package.description: MujocoActuatorTransport: SIL transport implementing the ActuatorTransport seam (ADR-007-01). Drives each joint's generated MJCF actuator with the MIT tuple, so MuJoCo evaluates the impedance law at every physics step. Steps physics in lockstep with integer substeps asserted at configure (ADR-007-03). Reports kFull tuple completeness.
